def solve(g):
 from collections import Counter
 cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
 color=min((c for c in cnt if c!=0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
 pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
 r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
 shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
 h=len(g);w=len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
 for dr in range(h-(max(r for r,c in shape)+1)+1):
  for dc in range(w-(max(c for r,c in shape)+1)+1):
   if all(g[dr+r][dc+c]==0 for r,c in shape):
    for r,c in shape: out[dr+r][dc+c]=color
 return out
pred2=solve(I)
print('demo2 matches', pred2==O, sum(a!=b for rowa,rowb in zip(pred2,O) for a,b in zip(rowa,rowb)))

code='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    marker = min((value for value in counts if value != 0), key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in points)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    shape_height = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    shape_width = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(height - shape_height + 1):
        for left in range(width - shape_width + 1):
            if all(grid[top + r][left + c] == 0 for r, c in shape):
                for r, c in shape:
                    output[top + r][left + c] = marker
    return output
'''
